$comment: Shot list for the final-check businesses (tools/eval/final10): English image-model prompts, keys <fixture id>/<NN>, the subject in brief.json is the source. Not generated yet: `pnpm fixtures:ai-photos generate --model gpt-image-2.5 --dir tools/eval/final10` makes them (paid, 15 pictures). `style` is appended to every prompt.
style: Realistic photograph taken with a good smartphone by the owner of a small business in Slovenia, for their own website. Natural available light, unstaged, true-to-life colours, ordinary everyday setting with small imperfections. No text, no lettering on signs or packaging, no logos, no watermark, no borders.

photos.kamp-soska/01: A small orange tent pitched on a meadow right beside a clear emerald-green mountain river with white pebbles, forested hills behind, early morning light.
photos.kamp-soska/02: A white motorhome parked on a gravel pitch under tall deciduous trees at a small family campsite, a folding chair and a small table beside it, dappled sunlight.
photos.kamp-soska/03: A shared campsite kitchen: a long worn wooden table, a shelf with pots and pans, a two-ring gas cooker and a window with a view of trees, clean and simple.
photos.knjigoveznica-kras/01: A hand-bound book with a dark brown leather cover and visible stitched spine lying on a wooden workbench, a bone folder and a ball of linen thread next to it.
photos.knjigoveznica-kras/02: Hands of a bookbinder sewing the pages of a book with thread on a wooden sewing frame in a small workshop, close view, soft window light.
photos.knjigoveznica-kras/03: A workshop shelf with stacks of hand-made notebooks and sheets of coloured paper in muted tones, a press in the background.
photos.slascicarna-pri-zofki/01: Two cream slices with a golden crust on a white plate beside a cup of coffee on a wooden counter of a small pastry shop, morning light.
photos.slascicarna-pri-zofki/02: A round homemade cake with whipped cream and fresh strawberries on a cake stand, plain tablecloth, a window behind it.
photos.slascicarna-pri-zofki/03: A glass display counter of a small pastry shop with trays of homemade cakes, a rolled walnut pastry cut in slices and apple strudel, warm indoor light.
photos.tapetnistvo-lesjak/01: An old armchair in an upholsterer's workshop with the worn fabric half torn off, the wooden frame and springs visible, tools on a workbench behind it.
photos.tapetnistvo-lesjak/02: A freshly reupholstered green fabric corner sofa in a tidy living room, afternoon light from a window, no people.
photos.tapetnistvo-lesjak/03: A workbench with fabric sample books, a pair of large scissors, a tape measure and an upholstery hammer, a few rolls of cloth leaning against the wall.
photos.zeliscarna-pri-lipi/01: Bunches of dried herbs hanging upside down from a wooden beam in a rustic room, lavender, yarrow and mint, soft side light.
photos.zeliscarna-pri-lipi/02: A wooden shelf in a small herb shop with glass jars of loose tea blends and herbs, paper bags and small dark tincture bottles, warm light.
photos.zeliscarna-pri-lipi/03: A cup of herbal tea with steam on a small wooden table by a window in a cosy tea room, a teapot and a sprig of dried flowers beside it.
